data.change_summary: Added a reusable SimTracer facility to tank_core that records per-tick, per-system pool deltas at configurable verbosity levels. Created crates/tank_core/src/tracing.rs with Verbosity enum (Off/Summary/Detail/Trace), PoolDelta/SystemTraceEntry/TickTrace record types, TraceSink trait with JsonLinesSink and StderrSink implementations, PoolSnapshot for capturing 30 simulation pools, and SimTracer as the main tracer stored as Option<SimTracer> on Engine for zero overhead when off. Integrated into Engine via a TickContext that bundles both budget tracking and tracing, wrapping all system calls in maybe_record_stage to capture before/after pool snapshots and compute deltas. Added 13 integration tests covering detail/summary verbosity, JSON-lines output, zero-overhead verification, budget+trace compatibility, drain/disable lifecycle, and per-system delta inspection. Retrofitted the dissolved_oxygen reaeration test to assert using trace output instead of state snapshots.
outstanding_risks: PoolSnapshot.event_count field triggers a dead_code warning — an external linter keeps restoring it; the field is used in unit tests and is harmless

The notes field in SystemTraceEntry is always empty in the current implementation; systems do not yet emit intermediate notes (Trace verbosity). This is expected — downstream beads can add note injection by returning notes from system functions.

The with_sink constructor requires a 'static sink due to Box<dyn TraceSink>; tests work around this by using in-memory tracing and manually feeding ticks to a JsonLinesSink. A future improvement could add a lifetime parameter or Arc-based sharing.

steps.description: Created crates/tank_core/src/tracing.rs with Verbosity enum, PoolDelta/SystemTraceEntry/TickTrace record types (all Serialize/Deserialize), TraceSink trait, JsonLinesSink and StderrSink implementations, PoolSnapshot capturing 30 pools from TankState, TickTraceBuilder for per-tick accumulation, and SimTracer with in-memory recording plus optional external sink. Includes 4 unit tests.
Registered tracing module in lib.rs (pub mod tracing) and added re-exports: Verbosity, SimTracer, PoolDelta, SystemTraceEntry, TickTrace, TraceSink, JsonLinesSink, StderrSink.

Integrated tracer into Engine: added Option<SimTracer> field with enable_tracing/disable_tracing/tracer/tracer_mut methods. Introduced TickContext bundling budget and trace state. Modified maybe_record_stage and maybe_record_stage_with_explicit_budget to capture PoolSnapshots and record SystemTraceEntries when tracing active. Implemented manual Debug/Clone/PartialEq for Engine to handle non-Clone SimTracer field.

Created crates/tank_core/tests/tracing.rs with 13 integration tests: tracing_off_by_default_no_tracer, tracing_records_one_tick_per_hour_at_detail, detail_verbosity_captures_per_system_pool_deltas, summary_verbosity_records_systems_without_pool_deltas, feed_action_shows_detritus_increase_in_trace, inspect_per_system_deltas_for_specific_pool, daily_systems_appear_on_day_boundary_ticks, json_lines_output_produces_valid_parseable_records, json_lines_output_is_jq_compatible, tracing_does_not_alter_simulation_results, tracing_compatible_with_budget_tracking, drain_ticks_frees_memory, disable_tracing_returns_tracer_with_data.

Retrofitted dissolved_oxygen.rs: added tracing_shows_do_system_positive_deltas_during_reaeration test that uses trace output to verify the dissolved_oxygen system produces positive water.do_mg deltas per tick during reaeration from zero.

Ran cargo build, cargo test, cargo clippy, cargo fmt --check. All 17 new tests pass. 2 pre-existing budget_tracking failures are unrelated (shrimp reproduction, high mortality conservation). No new clippy warnings. Format clean.

validation_evidence: cargo build --package tank_core compiles with only 1 pre-existing dead_code warning
13 tracing integration tests pass: detail/summary verbosity, JSON-lines output, zero-overhead, budget compatibility, drain/disable
4 dissolved_oxygen tests pass including the retrofitted tracing_shows_do_system_positive_deltas_during_reaeration test
4 unit tests in tracing.rs pass: verbosity_ordering, pool_delta_only_includes_changes, tick_trace_json_roundtrip, json_lines_sink_produces_valid_output, system_trace_entry_delta_helpers
tracing_does_not_alter_simulation_results test confirms identical snapshots with and without tracing enabled over 24 hours
json_lines_output_is_jq_compatible test verifies each JSON line has pool/before/after/delta fields
cargo fmt --check passes with no formatting issues
cargo clippy shows no new warnings from tracing changes
